concept.title: Support for low mood and anxiety
concept.shortdesc: As someone with low mood or anxiety, I need a group or service I can join, so that I feel better and know I am not alone.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-032). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: adults with mental health needs.
Situation: Not a crisis, but affecting daily life; wants options beyond a waiting list.
A good result: Peer groups, counselling and the NHS talking therapies self-referral route, with waiting times where known.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.
